purpose: Focused static closure for the startup-built DS:7974 byte table consumed by BIENE state 1, including its seed, software-floating-point helper chain, and simulation feedback boundary.

builder.name: initialize_game_state
builder.calling_convention: far, no source-level arguments; startup initializer
static_control_flow: Fills DS:646C[0..0xff] with scaled 0227:1959 output using parameter 0x100.
For index 0..0x3e7, stores 0xffff at DS:6D8E[index] before building the table byte.
For index 0..0x7ff, runs the relocated software-float helper sequence and stores AL at DS:7974[index].

coefficient_block.format: Seven consecutive six-byte software-float records consumed by 0227:190A; exact field interpretation remains address-qualified.

helper_contracts.name: dos_time_seed_19EE
helper_contracts.inputs_outputs: No stable source arguments; AH=0x2c INT 21h returns DOS time in CX:DX.
helper_contracts.return_flags: DOS interrupt result; not consumed by 01F7:0A43
helper_contracts.simulation_feedback: Indirectly affects DS:646C through 0227:1959; no direct callback-state write

helper_contracts.name: prng_state_step_19B6
helper_contracts.inputs_outputs: Consumes 32-bit state at 35FA:35FC and updates it with the 16-bit literal 0x8405; return is the updated scaled-state pair used by 1959.
helper_contracts.return_flags: Carry participates in the 32-bit update; exact caller-visible flags are address-qualified

helper_contracts.name: scaled_prng_1959
helper_contracts.inputs_outputs: Parameter on stack scales the value returned by 19B6; call site passes 0x0100 and receives a byte-range result.
helper_contracts.return_flags: Carry is preserved/returned by the scaling path; do not infer from a C integer return
helper_contracts.simulation_feedback: DS:646C startup ring used by object/effect factories

helper_contracts.name: far_fill_1B7E
helper_contracts.inputs_outputs: Far REP STOSB; stack arguments are segment:offset, byte value, and count; RETF 8.

helper_contracts.name: runtime_float_wrappers_14AC_14B2_14C0_14CC
helper_contracts.inputs_outputs: Wrapper calls into the software-floating-point implementation and propagates arithmetic/range flags. Error paths write DOS runtime error globals and may invoke INT 21h.
helper_contracts.return_flags: CF and arithmetic flags are part of the ABI; Ghidra C output is not authoritative
helper_contracts.simulation_feedback: Can affect the generated table only; no direct player/global callback writes

helper_contracts.name: software_float_coefficient_fold_18F1_190A
helper_contracts.inputs_outputs: 18F1 multiplies the current six-byte value by a supplied six-byte value, then 190A folds seven six-byte CS:1646 coefficients through 1189/124C and returns the final 124C product. The coefficient pointer advances by six bytes per LOOP iteration.
helper_contracts.return_flags: Final 124C packed result and arithmetic flags; exact register/flag ABI is retained from the listing
helper_contracts.simulation_feedback: Determines the generated DS:7974 byte for the 15E5 large-value path

helper_contracts.name: software_float_helper_chain_0227
helper_contracts.inputs_outputs: Software floating-point arithmetic, normalization, compare, transform, and rounding helpers called by the table builder.
helper_contracts.return_flags: Exact packed-value register layout and CF/ZF contracts remain address-qualified
helper_contracts.simulation_feedback: Determines DS:7974 bytes consumed by BIENE state 1

simulation_feedback.closed_boundary: Startup builder control flow, storage range, helper call order, and non-player side effects are statically closed. Exact initialized table bytes are not yet native-portable.
